name: gateways
description: Modular SDK for payment gateway integrations: full frappe/payments port (Payment Gateway doctype plus Braintree, GoCardless, Mpesa, Paymob, PayPal, Paytm, Razorpay and Stripe gateway settings) flattened into a single composed frappe module, plus Rokct's own PayFast and Paystack gateways (gateways/local overlay). Fork of frappe/payments (MIT) via Frappenize/payments@rokct. Control flavor (src/control/): the hub-side PaystackController verify/charge delegate imported by the control plane's subscription billing - importable code only, so app_type.control declares no hooks; the persona split still strips src/control/ out of tenant composes and src/tenant/ out of control composes.
